purpose: Teach: 前線/最前線/対峙/誹謗/出頭/無垢/撃た/説く

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療の前線、本当に、毎日、勝負ですよ、患者さんの命、守るために、医師、本当に、全力で、向き合っております、本当に、絶対に、譲れない、立場ですね。
lines.en: Ren — medicine is a front-line responsibility. Every single day, it's about life and death. As doctors, we face this with absolute commitment. There's no room for compromise in what we do.
lines.style: Steady, composed delivery. Clear weight on 'front-line' and 'absolute.' Unhurried pace. The voice of someone who has seen what matters. No drama, just clear-eyed certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の最前線、本当に、頭が下がる、思いです、先生、いつも、本当に、ご活躍、応援、しております、市民として、感謝、しております、本当に、深く。
lines.en: The medical front line deserves our deepest respect. Sensei, I genuinely admire your dedication and all you do every day. As someone in this community, I'm truly grateful. Deeply.
lines.style: Genuine, slightly formal gratitude. Slower pace on the last sentence. Soft but firm conviction — not performing respect, actually feeling it. Eyes down slightly, then back up.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。重い病と、対峙する患者さん、本当に、勇気、ある方々ですね、医師として、本当に、応援、させていただいております、寄り添う、姿勢、忘れずに、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The patients facing serious illness — they show remarkable courage. As a doctor, I do my best to support them, to stand beside them through it. That's something I never forget.
lines.style: Gentle but grounded. Slower on 'remarkable courage.' Slight pause before 'stand beside them' — the commitment lands with quiet weight. Warm but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療従事者への、ネット誹謗、本当に、心が、痛みますね、先生、本当に、頑張っていらっしゃる方々を、傷つけないで欲しいですね、本当に、社会、変えていかないと。
lines.en: The online abuse directed at healthcare workers — it really does hurt to see. Sensei, please know that people appreciate your hard work. But we have to push back against this in our society. We have to change this culture.
lines.style: Careful opening, then building conviction. Voice steadies on 'push back.' Not angry, but determined. Slight lean forward on 'we have to change.' Personal stake becoming visible.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さん、自主的に、病院に、出頭、される方も、増えております、最近、健康意識、高まっているんですね、本当に、嬉しい、変化ですね、社会の。
lines.en: Yes. More patients are seeking care voluntarily now, taking charge of their own health. It's a positive shift — I'm genuinely glad to see it. It speaks to something changing in society for the better.
lines.style: Observational, measured tone. Slight warmth on 'genuinely glad.' Even pace, grounded. This is factual but also contains quiet satisfaction. No exaggeration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 無垢な、お子様の患者さん、本当に、お見舞いする、と、胸が、締め付けられますね、先生、医師として、辛い場面、たくさん、ありますよね、本当に、お疲れ様、本当に。
lines.en: Seeing innocent children who are patients — when I visit, something in my chest tightens. Sensei, you face so many difficult moments in this work. I can only imagine how much it takes from you. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Soft opening, genuine pain beneath. Voice thins slightly on 'chest tightens.' Pause before addressing the doctor. Respect mixed with recognition of burden. Ends quietly, with real weight.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。戦時、医師、撃たれた事例も、歴史上、あったそうですね、本当に、痛ましい、歴史、です、医療の歴史、深いですね、本当に、勉強、続けないと、いけませんね。
lines.en: Yes. History shows us that doctors have even been harmed — killed, in wartime. It's a painful reality. Medicine has such a deep history. We have to keep studying, keep learning. It's a responsibility.
lines.style: Grave, quiet tone. Pause after 'killed' — letting the weight land. No melodrama. Philosophical slightly, but grounded. The pace slows on final sentences. Speaking from understanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の倫理を、説く先生方、本当に、立派な、姿勢ですよね、私、本当に、見習いたいと、思っております、絶対、私も、医療研究、続けていきたいです、本当に。
lines.en: The teachers who speak about medical ethics — they truly exemplify what it means to act with integrity. I really do want to learn from that example. And I want to continue my own research in medicine. Genuinely.
lines.style: Earnest throughout. Slight emphasis on 'learn from that example.' Building toward the close. The final 'genuinely' lands with quiet resolve — not performance, actual commitment. Voice steadies.
